map.输入劳动力总数与失业人数，计算失业率（失业者占劳动力比例），用于宏观经济就业状况: Enter the total labour force and the number of unemployed to compute the unemployment rate (unemployed as a share of the labour force), for macroeconomic employment measurement.
map.劳动力中失业者所占比例。: The share of unemployed in the labour force.
map.失业测算：录入失业与劳动力，算失业率。: Unemployment measurement: enter unemployed and labour force to get the rate.
map.趋势观察：对比多期失业率变化。: Trend watching: compare unemployment rates across periods.
map.教学演示：演示劳动力口径不含退出者。: Teaching demo: show that the labour force excludes those who have left.
map.：示例：失业 400 万、劳动力 7000 万，失业率=400/7000≈5.7: : Example: 4 million unemployed, 70 million labour force, unemployment rate=400/7000≈5.71%.
map.劳动力（就业+失业），不含不在劳动力者，故参与率影响解读。结果仅作经济学教学与快: The labour force (employed + unemployed), excluding those not in the labour force, so the participation rate affects interpretation. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimates only, not investment advice or policy basis; defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks for forecasts and empirical estimates.
map.不含摩擦性失业的最低可持续失业率，约 4–5%，高于此或示需求不足。结果仅作经济: The lowest sustainable unemployment rate excluding frictional unemployment, about 4–5%; above that may signal insufficient demand. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimates only, not investment advice or policy basis; defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
map.常用 U3 为狭义失业，U6 含准失业与边际劳动力，口径更广。结果仅作经济学教学: U3, commonly used, is the narrow definition; U6 includes discouraged workers and marginally attached labour, a broader measure. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimates only, not investment advice or policy basis; defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
